description: This file declares functions, classes, and interfaces for displaying and managing dialogs in the Wesnoth game, including drawing dialog frames, handling dialog actions, and showing various dialog types.

classes.name: gui::dialog_manager
classes.description: Manages dialog state, ensuring proper setup and teardown during dialog display.

classes.name: gui::dialog_action
classes.description: Abstract base class for dialog actions, defining the interface for executing dialog-related actions.

classes.name: gui::dialog_button_action
classes.description: Abstract base class for dialog button actions, handling button press results.

classes.name: gui::dialog_button
classes.description: Represents a dialog button with an associated action handler and label.

classes.name: gui::preview_pane
classes.description: Interface for a preview pane shown beside dialogs to display additional information about selections.

classes.name: gui::check_item
classes.description: Represents a checkbox item within dialogs, with label and checked state.

methods.name: gui::in_dialog
methods.description: Checks if a dialog is currently active.

methods.name: gui::draw_dialog_frame
methods.description: Draws the frame of a dialog at specified position and size.

methods.name: gui::draw_dialog_background
methods.description: Draws the background of a dialog.

methods.name: gui::draw_dialog_title
methods.description: Draws the dialog title and returns the area it occupies.

methods.name: gui::draw_dialog
methods.description: Renders a complete dialog with title, buttons, and optional help button.

methods.name: gui::show_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with specified parameters and returns user selection.

methods.name: gui::network_data_dialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog for network data input or status.

methods.name: gui::network_connect_dialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog to connect to a network host.

methods.name: gui::check_quit
methods.description: Checks for quit events and handles them appropriately.
